mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different mechanisms (benzodiazepine GABA agonism and antipsychotic dopamine antagonism), with additive sedative and psychomotor impairment effects; prochlorperazine may also inhibit alprazolam metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, cognitive impairment, and motor dysfunction; consider dose reduction or alternative antiemetic; counsel on avoiding alcohol and hazardous activities.
